online co op for twilight princess. 2 to 16 players in one world.

put crests_of_courage.dusk in dusklight's mods folder. a co op tab shows up in the menu bar.
one player presses host and reads out the room, everyone else types it and presses join.

only windows has been played. mac, linux, android and ios are built here but untested.
enemy sync, boss sync and story progress are off by default under unfinished.

this version needs dusklight 2.0.2, and everyone has to update: it only connects to 1.7.3. from now on, only the exact same version connects.

this build:
- poe souls now go to everyone. killing a poe only gave the soul to whoever killed it
- in the randomizer, whatever a poe (or another queued check) gives you now goes to everyone too
- a sword or shield you get from someone else is now equipped if you had none (the wooden sword came
  with nothing in your hand), or if it replaces yours: ordon sword over the wooden one, ordon shield
  over the wooden one, light sword over the master sword
- fixed a crash that could happen the moment you took out a fishing rod
- other players' epona is smooth now: no more stuttering legs, and the rider stays on her at a gallop instead of trailing and catching up
- clawshot someone who's hanging from a peahat to hang off them. works with pvp on or off
